changes.title: Brooms
items: Five new brooms to pick in your room's Broom box
Battering: your blinks stun the creatures in your path
Ley jump: press R to jump to the ley line's pulse
Haul: your sigils pull on you half as hard
Ground pound: press R to rise or land at once, knocking creatures back; landing stuns them
Stealth: creatures don't see you unless you're inviting, or putting something down or picking it up

changes.title: Dreams grow
items: A sleeping legend's dream bubble is as big as its speech bubble now, and the sleepers' 😴s grow with them too

changes.title: Treehouse ent
items: The treehouse Ent is here: a great kneeling tree holding the deck up, its lanterns lit, your decks along its front
The map table shows a living miniature of the sea chart, and E there opens the chart itself over the game
